claim: For fixed d>=3,J,tau>0,R>=0, Lambda_L={1,...,L}^d with Dirichlet nearest-neighbour h_L=J sum_a(2I-T_a-T_a*), beta=tau L^2, common lambda<=0 and rho_0 proportional to exp[-beta(dGamma(h_L)-(lambda/L^2)N)], let P_R forbid on-site double occupancy and all distinct pairs at l-infinity distance <=R. For any L-dependent nonnegative closed form W_L such that G_0+W_L is a self-adjoint form sum, Ran(P_R) is in Dom(q_W) with q_W identically zero there, and the Gibbs operator is trace class, D(rho_W||rho_0)<=C[L^(2-d)+L^(-d)log(L+1)] and ||rho_W-rho_0||_1<=sqrt(2C[L^(2-d)+L^(-d)log(L+1)]). The constant is independent of lambda and W_L; W_L need not conserve N.
inputs: lambda<=0 is unknown and may vary with L
W_L is an arbitrary positive closed form subject to the stated zero-subspace and form-sum conditions
dependencies: Gibbs variational principle and quantum Pinsker
limits: Hard projection argument gives no vanishing estimate at d=2
No efficient Gibbs-state preparation or decoder runtime
No application to higher-dimensional hard-core spins by Jordan-Wigner
External proof validation and novelty/priority are UNKNOWN

claim: For n independent admissible interacting copies sharing the same unknown lambda<=0, relative entropy additivity and Pinsker give trace distance at most sqrt(2 n G_L) from the n-copy free reference, where G_L=C[L^(2-d)+L^(-d)log(L+1)]. The free family is an exponential family with exact sufficient statistic T=sum_j N_j. Measuring T and preparing its lambda-independent free canonical conditional state is a fixed EB channel and reconstructs the interacting product with error at most 2sqrt(2 n G_L). For d>=3, n=o(L^(d-2)) is sufficient for vanishing full-state EB reconstruction error. A Chernoff number cutoff uses O(log(n+1)+loglog(1/delta)) classical bits and zero persistent quantum memory for tail tolerance delta; decoder preparation/access/runtime are unproved.
inputs: each copy satisfies the positive collision-supported penalty hypotheses; penalties may differ across copies
limits: Different unknown lambda_j per copy are outside the scalar total-number sufficient statistic
No preparation, finite-precision compilation, output-size, or runtime claim
Sufficient copy scaling only; optimality UNKNOWN
